briefdescription.para: C++ source file with implementations for the µTest++ TAP suite reporter methods.

detaileddescription.para: This source file contains the implementations for reporter_tap, a concrete implementation of the reporter abstract interface that formats suite results according to the Test Anything Protocol (TAP).
All definitions reside within the micro_os_plus::micro_test_plus namespace, ensuring clear separation from user code and minimising the risk of naming conflicts.
This file must be included when building the µTest++ library.
